name: Nude King
source:
"I'm the naked king who holds nothing and wears nothing. Besides this power of darkness of course."

He was once a kind king who loved his country.
But he made a contract with a person of darkness and gained a great power and was corrupted. He started scheming to sink the world into darkness.
There is no trace of his former self left, he's now selfish and arrogant.
[spoiler]For the majority of the game he is possessed by Loki.[/spoiler]
